description: This Java class 'AndroidResourceFilesListener' listens for file system changes related to Android resource files within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment. It processes resource file events, schedules updates, and triggers resource compilation tasks for Android projects.

classes.name: AndroidResourceFilesListener
classes.description: A listener class for Android resource file changes, managing update scheduling and resource compilation.

classes.name: MyUpdate
classes.description: Inner class extending Update, responsible for processing file change events and triggering resource generation.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Handles file system change events, filters relevant files, and queues updates.

methods.name: getFilesToProcess
methods.description: Filters VFileEvents to determine which files should trigger resource updates.

methods.name: shouldScheduleUpdate
methods.description: Determines if a file change should trigger a resource update based on file type and location.

methods.name: notifyFacetInitialized
methods.description: Stores the package name from the manifest into the facet's user data upon initialization.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the resource generation process for affected files.

methods.name: computeCompilersToRunAndInvalidateLocalAttributesMap
methods.description: Computes which resource compilers to run based on changed files and invalidates local attribute definitions.

methods.name: computeCompilersToRunAndInvalidateLocalAttributesMap
methods.description: Determines specific compiler modes needed for a given file.

methods.name: invalidateAttributeDefinitions
methods.description: Invalidates resource attribute definitions for specified modules.

methods.name: canEat
methods.description: Checks if the update can be handled by this MyUpdate instance.
